title: Lemony greens & white bean pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta until just tender. Reserve a mug of pasta water.
Warm olive oil in a skillet. Add sliced garlic and cook gently until fragrant, then stir in the drained beans.
Add spinach, lemon zest and juice, and a splash of pasta water. Fold until the greens wilt.
Toss with the drained pasta. Season generously and finish with extra lemon.

title: Ginger salmon rice bowls
steps: Cook rice according to the package directions. Fluff and keep warm.
Stir soy sauce, grated ginger and lime juice together. Brush over the salmon.
Bake salmon at 220°C / 425°F for 10 to 12 minutes, until just cooked through.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber and the remaining ginger-lime dressing.

title: Coconut chickpea curry
steps: Soften the diced onion in a deep pan with a little oil, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for a minute, then add tomatoes and coconut milk.
Add drained chickpeas and simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Fold in spinach until wilted. Taste, season and serve with rice or warm flatbread.

title: Jammy tomato & ricotta toast
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add tomatoes and a pinch of salt.
Cook for 7 to 9 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until tomatoes soften and burst.
Toast the sourdough and spread each slice with ricotta.
Spoon tomatoes and their juices over the toast. Finish with torn basil and black pepper.

title: Smoky lentil & carrot soup
steps: Dice the onion and carrots. Soften in a pot with olive oil for 7 minutes.
Stir in smoked paprika and tomato paste, then add rinsed lentils and vegetable stock.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes.
Season to taste. Blend a few ladles for a thicker texture, if you like.

title: Crispy black bean tacos
steps: Drain the beans and warm them in a pan with cumin, salt and a splash of water.
Finely shred the cabbage and toss with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and lightly charred at the edges.
Fill tortillas with beans and cabbage. Add sliced avocado and serve with lime.

title: Apple cinnamon overnight oats
steps: Divide oats and milk between two jars or bowls and stir to combine.
Grate half the apple into each jar. Add yogurt, cinnamon and maple syrup.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir before eating and top with the remaining thinly sliced apple.

title: Sesame peanut noodle salad
steps: Cook rice noodles following the package directions, then rinse under cool water.
Whisk tahini, soy sauce, lime juice and a little warm water into a smooth dressing.
Cut carrot and pepper into thin ribbons. Toss with the noodles and dressing.
Taste and adjust with more lime or soy sauce. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Green shakshuka with herbs
steps: Slice the leek and cook in olive oil in a lidded skillet until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add peas and spinach with a splash of water. Stir until the spinach wilts.
Make four wells in the greens and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook until set to your liking.
Spoon yogurt over the top, add chopped dill and serve with crusty bread.

title: Harissa cauliflower traybake
steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F. Cut cauliflower into florets and drain the chickpeas.
Toss cauliflower and chickpeas with harissa, olive oil and salt on a baking tray.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until the cauliflower has dark edges.
Serve with yogurt, lemon juice and chopped parsley.

title: Fluffy banana oat pancakes
steps: Mash the banana in a bowl, then whisk in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in oats, baking powder and a pinch of salt. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat, 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with maple syrup and fresh fruit.

title: Lemon chicken & crispy potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F. Halve the potatoes and place in a roasting tin.
Toss potatoes with olive oil, grated lemon zest, oregano and crushed garlic.
Nestle chicken thighs among the potatoes. Season and roast for 40 to 45 minutes.
Squeeze lemon juice over the tray and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Pear, walnut & blue cheese salad
steps: Whisk balsamic vinegar with olive oil, salt and a little black pepper.
Arrange salad leaves on two plates. Thinly slice the pear and scatter over the top.
Crumble blue cheese over the salad and add the walnuts.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

title: Roasted tomato & red pepper soup
steps: Heat oven to 210°C / 410°F. Halve tomatoes and peppers; quarter the onion.
Arrange vegetables and garlic on a tray, drizzle with oil and roast for 30 minutes.
Tip roasted vegetables into a pot, add stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season to taste and serve with toasted bread.

title: Honeyed yogurt & stone fruit bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl and swirl through half the honey.
Slice the peaches and arrange over the yogurt.
Top with granola and pumpkin seeds, then drizzle over the remaining honey.

title: One-pot spinach pesto orzo
steps: Add orzo and stock to a wide pan. Bring to a simmer, stirring often.
Cook for 10 to 12 minutes until the orzo is tender and most stock is absorbed.
Stir in pesto, spinach and lemon zest until the spinach wilts.
Finish with lemon juice and grated parmesan. Loosen with a splash of water if needed.
